title: Documented key stored base64- or hex-encoded as a config value
summary: The value of a config assignment decodes, whole, to the ExampleCloud live key.
rationale: The decoded bytes are exactly the documented key grammar; the encoding changes where the key is written, not what it is.

expectation.rationale: Project policy of this example: a value that decodes to a documented credential is that credential, and the source range to cover is the encoded text. Not provider-documented.

notes: Worked example for the representation guide (ADR 0016). Synthetic; the policy stated here is an example, not a claim about any product.
